name: Redact Tools for Discord
author: redact

sections.description:
Give your visitors three Discord tools that work right on your site:

  • Account age – paste a user ID, @mention or profile link to see when the account was made, how old it is, and whether it’s brand new.
  • ID decoder – paste any Discord ID or message link to see exactly when it was created.
  • Timestamp – pick a date and time and copy a <t:...> tag that shows in each reader’s own time zone.

Everything runs in the visitor’s browser. Nothing they type is sent to Discord, to Redact or to your server, and the plugin loads no outside scripts, fonts or trackers.

Usage

  • Widget: Appearance > Widgets, add “Redact Tools for Discord”.
  • Block: add the “Discord Tools” block to any post, page or block widget area. Its “Custom colors” panel offers your theme’s palette.
  • Shortcode: [redact_discord_tools]

Shortcode options:

  • title – heading text. Empty hides it. Default “Discord Tools”.
  • tools – which panels to show, in order: age, snowflake, timestamp. Default age,timestamp.
  • theme – auto (follows the visitor’s light or dark setting), light or dark.
  • bg, text, accent – your own background, text and button colors as hex codes, such as bg="#fdf6e3". Each one left out uses the theme setting. A dark bg switches the rest of the widget to its dark style.

Examples:

  • [redact_discord_tools tools="timestamp" theme="dark"]
  • [redact_discord_tools bg="#fdf6e3" text="#3b2f1e" accent="#e07a1f"]
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release: account age checker, ID decoder and timestamp generator as a widget, block and shortcode, with your own background, text and button colors.

short_description: Discord timestamp generator, account age checker and Discord ID (snowflake) decoder for your sidebar, posts or pages.
